item.coloph: bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byed pa'i sngags lam rin po che/ sngar med gsar du phye ba'i bdag mdun gyi mngon rtogs 'di ni/ skyabs kyi ston pas brjed pa gso ba'i phyir dang / nang chen bstan pa rgyal mtshan pa'i thugs dam du thugs bzhed nas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ mdo rgyal dil ra'i yang dben du sbyar ba'o//
